items.title: China, U.S. discuss tariff cuts ahead of Trump-Xi meeting next week
items.summary: Investing.com -- China and the United States discussed tariff reductions and agricultural trade during their first trade council meeting on Friday, as both countries seek progress on a proposed $60 billion tariff-cutting agreement ahead of talks between Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.
